title: OVERSTEER is continuing its makeover - Skyboxes, textures, moving suspension geometry, & more models
author: Grobot93
selftext:
This game has come a really long way in the past few months and I wanted to take the opportunity to show off the look and feel in its current state. I most recently got some cc0 skyboxes from [opengameart.com](http://opengameart.com) (amazing free resource for those who do not know about it) and matched up the sun to its position in the sky and it just adds SO much immersion to the game. Shadows look like they come from somewhere, not just a blank sky with a sun in it. The light from the boost flame lighting up the back of the car and the shadows is so cool to see. 

More to come soon. The game is inching ever closer to an early access release, and probably some sort of playtest in a few weeks to a month. If you are interested in following along, please join the discord [https://discord.gg/cCV2Knwg3](https://discord.gg/cCV2Knwg3)

comments.author: Square-Yam-3772
comments.body: the visual style looks good. the gameplay looks a bit too straightforward though...

replies.author: Grobot93
replies.body: So far I am mostly showing off the driving and environments. There are some more interesting ability kits I have mostly worked out, and the AI do not use any of the kits yet, so I can see how it can come off simpler than it is. Either way, thank you for the feedback. Let me know if there is something you think could make it more interesting gameplay-wise.

replies.author: Square-Yam-3772
replies.body: I haven't really played any driving games lately (besides the simple free ones online) so I wouldnt know what I look for. AIs should use abilities for sure though. otherwise it would not be challenging

replies.author: Grobot93
replies.body: Agreed. Once I am more or less done with tuning the abilities for the player, I can start programming the AI to use them. NPC characters have been a pretty big challenge to get working well. I am on version 6 of the AI brain for the NPC characters already.

comments.author: dilberry
comments.body: Looks great man - awesome job. The game looks amazing as-is. I'm not sure what the market is for this sort of racing game these days, but you've made it look awful good.

replies.author: Grobot93
replies.body: Thanks so much! I have been having a blast playing it while making it so hopefully the fact that it is a fun game sells itself.
